The complete game

MMA

A full-contact combat sport that blends striking and grappling, standing and on the ground. The flagship program, where every other discipline comes together.

01 / 07
Ground control

BJJ / Submission Wrestling

Grappling and ground fighting, joint locks, choke holds, position and pressure. A self-defence system built on leverage, not size.

02 / 07
Stand and strike

Kickboxing

A stand-up combat sport built on kicking and punching, footwork, timing, power. Sharp hands, sharper shins.

03 / 07
Art of eight limbs

Muay Thai

Fists, elbows, knees and shins, Thailand's striking art, drilled on pads and in the clinch the way it was meant to be fought.

04 / 07
Decide where it goes

Wrestling

Clinch fighting, throws, takedowns, pins and grappling holds. The discipline that decides whether the fight stays standing or hits the floor.

05 / 07
Fat loss · Conditioning

Warrior Fit

Fight-style conditioning focused on burning body fat and building the body you always wanted, no ring required, all the intensity kept.

Little Warriors

A light-contact class where kids learn technique, drill pads and build real fitness, discipline and confidence from the first session.

Learn from firsts

Coaches who
made history

Alpha Omega's corner is its biggest asset. The academy's coaches have competed nationally and internationally, and collected Kolkata firsts that nobody here had done before them.

Head Coach · MMA

Sreelakshmi
Gupta

The first female MMA gold medallist at the sub-continental championships.

A champion who has stood on top of the podium at continental level, and now builds fighters the same way she was built: technique first, excuses never.

Gold

Head Coach · BJJ

Shibashish
Banerjee

The first Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu blue belt in Kolkata.

He brought the gentle art to this city before anyone else here held rank in it. Every grappler on these mats traces their ground game back to that first belt.

BJJ
The Rhys Dykes
lineage

Both head coaches were trained by Rhys Dykes, a Gracie brown belt from Australia, world champion and competitor. The technique on these mats descends directly from the Gracie line.
